chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
If you travel through fertile land, then be gentle in traveling; and if you travel through barren land, then hasten in traveling.

key_terms.أَرْضٍ خِصْبَةٍ: fertile land rich in vegetation and resources
key_terms.أَرْضٍ مُجْدِبَةٍ: barren land lacking growth and sustenance
key_terms.بِالسَّيْرِ: in the course of travel or movement
key_terms.فَارْفُقْ: be gentle and proceed with care

ai.seo_question: How should one travel through fertile and barren land according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches consideration and proper conduct while traveling, especially in relation to the conditions of the land being crossed. It instructs one to move gently in fertile land and to hasten through barren land, reflecting ethical care and practical wisdom.
